description: Implement safeguards to prevent accidental mutation of query plans throughout the query execution pipeline. This involves making query plan data structures immutable by default and ensuring safe cloning where modifications are necessary.
functional_requirements: Mark all query plan components as readonly in the query interpreter to prevent unintended mutations
Introduce type utilities for deep readonly/unreadonly transformations to enforce immutability at the type level
Implement safer cloning mechanisms where query plan modifications are actually required
Make parameter and field collections readonly in public API signatures
Add comprehensive tests covering query plan cache mutation scenarios and paging edge cases
Apply immutability enforcement consistently across the query runtime, rendering pipeline, and in-memory processing components
